name: Bowls
description: A table of metal singing bowls tuned to a key: play in the key and the bowls you touch sing with you and ring on after, each with its own slow beat and its place between the sides.

params.name: Root
params.description: The key the bowls are tuned in. Match it to the key of the music so the bowls ring with the notes you play.

params.name: Scale
params.description: The notes of the key that have a bowl. Few notes leave more of the playing unanswered; Fifths is a root, its fifth and the fifth above that.

params.name: Bowls
params.description: How many bowls stand on the table. Each one added is the next note of the scale above the others.

params.name: Ring
params.description: How long a bowl rings after the sound that touched it. Under a few seconds the low bowls tell a note from its neighbour less well.

params.name: Beat
params.description: How far from round the bowls are. At the bottom each rings steady; higher splits every partial in two that beat against each other, faster as it rises.

params.name: Strike
params.description: How hard the playing drives the bowls. Low is a quiet answer to notes on a bowl's pitch; high rings them louder and lets every attack strike the bowls near it.

params.name: Metal
params.description: The brightness of the metal. Low is dull bronze that hums on its lowest tone; high adds the upper partials, strongest when a bowl is struck.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the dry signal and the ringing bowls. Fully up is the bowls alone.

params.name: Spread
params.description: How far apart the bowls sit between left and right. At the bottom they all ring from the centre.

params.name: Register
params.description: Where the set sits. Low is a few large deep bowls, high is small bright ones; the set moves along the scale a bowl at a time.

origin.note: Modal singing bowls driven in sympathy by the input: three partial pairs per bowl as complex rotators on cpp/kit, fed through resonators on each note, tuned to a key.
